entries.title: Psalms 72:1
segments: ¶<<[A Psalm] for Solomon.>> Give the king thy judgments, O God, and thy righteousness unto the king's son. {for: or, of}

entries.title: Psalms 72:2
segments: ¶He shall judge thy people with righteousness, and thy poor with judgment.

entries.title: Psalms 72:3
segments: The mountains shall bring peace to the people, and the little hills, by righteousness.

entries.title: Psalms 72:4
segments: He shall judge the poor of the people, he shall save the children of the needy, and shall break in pieces the oppressor.

entries.title: Psalms 72:5
segments: They shall fear thee as long as the sun and moon endure, throughout all generations.

entries.title: Psalms 72:6
segments: He shall come down like rain upon the mown grass: as showers [that] water the earth.

entries.title: Psalms 72:7
segments: In his days shall the righteous flourish; and abundance of peace so long as the moon endureth. {so long...: Heb. till there be no moon}

words.text: endureth. {so long...: Heb. till there be no moon}

entries.title: Psalms 72:8
segments: He shall have dominion also from sea to sea, and from the river unto the ends of the earth.

entries.title: Psalms 72:9
segments: They that dwell in the wilderness shall bow before him; and his enemies shall lick the dust.

words.text: They that dwell in the wilderness

entries.title: Psalms 72:10
segments: The kings of Tarshish and of the isles shall bring presents: the kings of Sheba and Seba shall offer gifts.

entries.title: Psalms 72:11
segments: Yea, all kings shall fall down before him: all nations shall serve him.

entries.title: Psalms 72:12
segments: For he shall deliver the needy when he crieth; the poor also, and [him] that hath no helper.

words.text: also, and [him] that hath no helper

entries.title: Psalms 72:13
segments: He shall spare the poor and needy, and shall save the souls of the needy.

entries.title: Psalms 72:14
segments: He shall redeem their soul from deceit and violence: and precious shall their blood be in his sight.

entries.title: Psalms 72:15
segments: And he shall live, and to him shall be given of the gold of Sheba: prayer also shall be made for him continually; [and] daily shall he be praised. {shall be given: Heb. one shall give}

words.text: , and to him shall be given
. {shall be given: Heb. one shall give}

entries.title: Psalms 72:16
segments: There shall be an handful of corn in the earth upon the top of the mountains; the fruit thereof shall shake like Lebanon: and [they] of the city shall flourish like grass of the earth.

entries.title: Psalms 72:17
segments: His name shall endure for ever: his name shall be continued as long as the sun: and [men] shall be blessed in him: all nations shall call him blessed. {endure: Heb. be} {his name shall be...: Heb. shall be as a son to continue his father's name for ever}

words.text: . {endure: Heb. be} {his name shall be...: Heb. shall be as a son to continue his father's name for ever}

entries.title: Psalms 72:18
segments: ¶Blessed [be] the LORD God, the God of Israel, who only doeth wondrous things.

entries.title: Psalms 72:19
segments: And blessed [be] his glorious name for ever: and let the whole earth be filled [with] his glory; Amen, and Amen.

entries.title: Psalms 72:20
segments: The prayers of David the son of Jesse are ended.
